summary: "*** THIS ROW IS NOW THE EXPOSED ANTECEDENT (review-ajcr, run 0082 s0006).\
  \ Not because anything
here changed -- because the item next to it was discharged\
  \ and this one was behind it. ***

DEGREE CONVENTION (review-ajcr, current). The\
  \ exact degree-g face is consumer-specific, not an unconditional divisor producer.\
  \ The landed degree-window lemmas provide a reference divisor of degree at least\
  \ g on every campaign curve, and the Abel-source route is parameterized by n >=\
  \ g. Consumers that insist on degree exactly g (for example effectiveDivisorClassifyZar)\
  \ retain a separate degree-pin obligation; do not read this row's Div^g-lite title\
  \ as discharging it.

ajcr-p4 discharged the chart-finiteness (hlft) antecedent\
  \ at the real atlas (Pic0AtlasFiniteType.lean;
audited by me, it is a real discharge\
  \ and not a relocation -- see AJCR.w4-rep's arithmetic
correction). JacobianData\
  \ has FOUR fields, and with hlft gone the finiteness side of the datum is
down\
  \ to ONE open input, which is this row's: quasiCompact.

THE DISTINCTION THAT\
  \ MUST NOT BE BLURRED, and it is why the freeness next door does not help here:
\
  \ * PER-CHART compactness is FREE at the carrier the divisor-representability lane\
  \ returns
   (compactSpace_divScheme, DivSchemeQProj.lean) -- DivScheme is a closed\
  \ subscheme of the compact
   Grassmannian pair.
 * CompactSpace of the GLUED\
  \ object is NOT, and it is what JacobianData needs. For the
   class-indexed atlas\
  \ the index type is infinite, so the finite route JacobianData.ofCharts
   ([Finite\
  \ iota] + per-chart compactness) IS UNAVAILABLE, and ofChartsOfCompactSpace takes\
  \ the
   glued compactness directly.
Anyone quoting "compactness is free at the\
  \ carrier" for the glued form is making exactly the
conflation this note exists\
  \ to prevent. ajcr-p4 stated the distinction correctly in their own file;
keep\
  \ it.

SO THE ROUTE IS THIS ROW'S ROUTE, unchanged and now unavoidable: quasi-compactness\
  \ comes from the
ABEL IMAGE (JacobianData.ofChartsOfAbelImage), never from the\
  \ construction. The row's own analysis
below is intact and its correction-at-the-top\
  \ is honest about what "discharged" was wrong about.

WHY THE all-children-done\
  \ WARNING STAYS: recorded in I-0971 and unchanged -- degwindow being done
does\
  \ not close this row, which owes the image argument. Do not let a janitor set it\
  \ done.

DAT-J: JacobianData assembly -- quasi-compactness via the Abel image\
  \ of Div^g-lite.

*** CORRECTION AT THE TOP, 2026-07-29 (run 0071 s0016 close,\
  \ ajcr-divrep), against MY OWN header
below. A fresh-context audit (I-0799/I-0800/I-0802/I-0803)\
  \ refuted three of its claims. Commit
9753ad6e3; the Lean is unchanged and still\
  \ kernel-green, the PRICING was wrong.

WHAT SURVIVES: the effectivity half is\
  \ genuinely divRep-FREE (the audit cone-checked 323 files:
no divRepClassify, no\
  \ DivRepAffinePullback, no IsChartClause, no universal family), and the three
\
  theorems are real, sorry-free, rooted and axiom-clean.

WHAT IS REFUTED -- and\
  \ it is the word "discharged":
 (1) I called exists_effective_deg_eq_of_classDeg_eq_zero\
  \ a SATISFIABILITY PROBE and claimed the
     degree map hits g "unconditionally\
  \ on the curve". FALSE, arithmetically: CurveDivisor.deg is
     weighted by residue\
  \ degrees (Divisor.lean:61), so its image is index*Z. On a genus-1 curve of
  \
  \   index 3 over Q no divisor of degree 1 = g exists and the theorem is a VACUOUS\
  \ TRUTH. The
     campaign reference does not escape it: deg (m . fiberWeilDivisor)\
  \ = m*delta (WindowLedger:133)
     requires delta | g. So the face RELOCATES the\
  \ hypothesis (Z is an ARGUMENT), it does not
     discharge it. Exactly the reduction-to-a-possibly-false-hypothesis\
  \ trap this project has
     recorded twice -- passes every census because it IS\
  \ then a theorem.
 (2) THE BINDING LIMIT IS NOT THE DESCENT ONE I DISCLOSED. Since\
  \ the splitting field L is
     existential inside the proof, the reference binder\
  \ is UNIFORM: forall L, deg L (Zof L) = g,
     over every extension including\
  \ L = k. Strictly stronger than the degree-0 face asks, and it
     has NO PRODUCER\
  \ anywhere in the tree.
 (3) THE CONE IS NOT Challenge-FREE, which w4-datj 0.5/3.4\
  \ make BINDING for a DAT-J producer:
     DivisorDatumRankOne -> Cohomology/H1BaseFieldInvariance:6\
  \ -> Challenge. So "available today"
     does NOT mean "consumable by DJ-2/DJ-3\
  \ today". Separately: 0.5's own claim that FLVClass is
     Challenge-free is\
  \ also false at HEAD (Degree.lean:7 -> ChiCurve -> Challenge), so the standing
\
  \     "never riemann_inequality_curve" rule no longer avoids the cycle. Tree-wide,\
  \ pre-existing,
     and it needs its own decision.
 (4) A docstring advertised\
  \ PicRepDatum.exists_effective_deg_eq_at_point, which DOES NOT EXIST.
     So the\
  \ one face that would consume the Pic^0 universal property is absent; lam/hlam remain
\
  \     caller-supplied.

SO THE HONEST STATE OF THE EFFECTIVITY HALF: divRep-free,\
  \ and CONDITIONAL on an arithmetic
hypothesis about the curve's index that nothing\
  \ produces. Not discharged.

WHAT DAT-J OWES NOW: (a) a degree-g divisor over\
  \ the relevant field -- an index condition, newly
visible and genuinely open; (b)\
  \ descent from the splitting field to kappa(y) (dat-g); (c) the Abel
square at\
  \ an INDEPENDENTLY PINNED pt (the s0012 retraction stands); (d) a PicRepDatum from\
  \ DAT-G
(divRep-gated); (e) a Challenge-free route for the whole producer cone.\

DAT-J: JacobianData assembly\
  \ -- quasi-compactness via the Abel image of Div^g-lite.

*** THE EFFECTIVITY\
  \ HALF IS DISCHARGED AND WAS NEVER divRep-GATED, 2026-07-29 (run 0071 s0016,
ajcr-divrep).\
  \ Commits 053897f16 + c8a4563af + 127d7cccf; kernel EXIT=0, axiom-clean against\

control reporting sorryAx; root build 9288 jobs EXIT=0.

  exists_effective_deg_eq_of_classDeg_eq\
  \ (Picard/JacobianDataAbelEffective.lean)
    with chi(O) = 1 - g, a Cech Picard\
  \ class of degree g has an EFFECTIVE representative OF
    DEGREE g.  General:\
  \ any X, no relative curve, no pi.
  exists_effective_deg_eq_of_classDeg_eq_zero
\
  \    the satisfiability face AND the usable one -- a degree-ZERO class times a degree-g
\
  \    reference divisor.  The classes this row actually holds are of degree zero.
\
  \  exists_effective_deg_eq_of_pic0_at_point (Picard/JacobianDataAbelEffectivePoint.lean)
\
  \    from a point y of ANY Pic^0-representing object: a finite separable L over\
  \ kappa(y) and an
    effective degree-g divisor over L presenting the restricted\
  \ class.

THE GAP WAS ONE CONJUNCT, AND IT WAS A STATEMENT GAP. Every effectivity\
  \ lemma in the tree stops
at "0 <= E and picClass E = picClass W" with NO claim\
  \ about deg E (exists_effective_of_picClass
FLVClass:208, exists_effective_of_h0_pos\
  \ SectionBound:175), while effectiveDivisorClassifyZar
(DivisorFamilyFieldSurj:217)\
  \ demands 0 <= D AND deg D = g. Degree is a class invariant
(deg_eq_deg_of_picClass_eq),\
  \ so the missing conjunct transports for free off the class equation.

TWO COST\
  \ CLAIMS RETRACTED AT THEIR OWN SITES (not merely superseded here):
 * JacobianDataAbelImage\
  \ said DJ-1's brick "needs the universal degree-g class, hence divRep".
   It\
  \ does not. The five steps from a POINT to a divisor are all landed and all divRep-free:
\
  \   Over.testPoint (Pic0ChartTestPoint:176), mem_pic0Subgroup_iff, exists_splitting_of_picEt
\
  \   (Pic0ChartSplit:143, UNCONDITIONAL on the curve), classDeg_presenting_eq_zero
\
  \   (Pic0ChartCoverageDegreeStep2:98), then the brick.
 * The same docstring predicted\
  \ a fiberTwist shift. NONE is needed: at degree exactly g the RR
   entry condition\
  \ 1 <= deg W + chi(O) reads g <= deg W, so the class sits ON THE BOUNDARY and
\
  \   fires with no slack.

SO THE TWO HALVES OF STEP 3 WERE NEVER GATED ALIKE,\
  \ and this row priced them together -- hiding
a discharged half behind a gated\
  \ one. Only the Abel SQUARE is divRep-gated, because naming abel
at all requires\
  \ the representation.

WHAT REMAINS, exactly:
 (1) DESCENT, the honest new residue:\
  \ the divisor lives over the finite separable SPLITTING
     field L, while hlift\
  \ wants a morphism out of Spec kappa(y). That is dat-g's work.
 (2) the Abel-compatibility\
  \ square at a pt PINNED INDEPENDENTLY (the s0012 retraction below
     stands:\
  \ at a chosen pt the split is vacuous and its consumer is circular).
 (3) a PicRepDatum\
  \ k k C from DAT-G (divRep-gated).
 (4) the caller's degree-g reference divisor\
  \ Z -- over a small finite field a real hypothesis,
     not bookkeeping.
DJ-0\
  \ compact-image qc remains landed.

of a case split on exactly the two\

square is dif_pos.\
  \ No geometry, no surjectivity, no property of abel whatsoever.

WHY THE OLD PRICING\

IsAbelClassifyCompatible,\
  \ not fixed campaign data. A consumer entitled to choose pt can choose
the classifier\
  \ composite itself. This row called item 1 "bookkeeping-shaped, but a real
statement,\
  \ and nobody has written it" -- it is not a statement about abel at all. Recorded
\
  shape: I-0605 (a residue existentially quantified over the datum that would give\
  \ it content
demands nothing; inhabit it with junk BEFORE pricing it).

AND THE\
  \ CONSUMER IS CIRCULAR AT THAT WITNESS, which is the half that matters:
  heff_iff_conclusion_of_pt_eq\
  \ (same file)
At that pt, the remaining hypothesis heff of exists_residueField_lift_of_abelCompatible
\
  (JacobianDataAbelSquare.lean:158) unfolds to VERBATIM its own conclusion, so that\
  \ theorem is a
tautology there. heff had silently absorbed all the content item\
  \ 1 appeared to carry. So
exists_residueField_lift_of_abelCompatible is a reduction\
  \ only RELATIVE TO A pt PINNED
INDEPENDENTLY -- pinned to the campaign Abel map's\
  \ own point map -- and the interface never
pins it.

WHAT DAT-J NOW OWES, exactly\
  \ one statement:
  for every point y of J, an effective degree-g divisor D on the\
  \ curve over kappa(y) WHOSE
  CLASSIFYING MORPHISM COMPOSES WITH abel TO fromSpecResidueField\
  \ y.
The Riemann-Roch half produces D; the compatibility half is the honest residue.\
  \ The split into
"the square" plus "the geometry" CANNOT be restored: any pt\
  \ making the split statable is either
the pinned campaign one (in which case there\
  \ is no separate row) or a chosen one (in which case
the split is vacuous). Spelling\
  \ of the RR half stays BINDING per w4-datj 0.5:
exists_effective_of_picClass /\
  \ riemann_inequality (FLVClass.lean:208/205), NEVER
riemann_inequality_curve (ChiCurve.lean:183,\
  \ imports Challenge.lean -- import cycle).

STILL OPEN AND UNCHANGED: a PicRepDatum\
  \ k k C from DAT-G (divRep-gated).

CONSTRUCTION -- because the fibrewise\

The morphism half is\
  \ NOT gated and NOT missing. Picard/DivisorFamilyFieldSurj.lean (ROOTED,
sorry-free)\
  \ carries:
  DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_of_deg (:104) -- over a FIELD, an adaptation\
  \ whose presentation

  \ from a bare degree equation.
  exists_divFam_divFamDivisor_eq (:147); effectiveDivisorClassifyZar\
  \ (:217), spec at (:231).

THE STRATEGIC POINT, and it is the sharp form of critical-path\
  \ 7.6's own argument: the
DivFamZar no-go is a purely RELATIVE phenomenon (over\
  \ a field a divisor's support is finitely
many closed points, so IsPreconnected\
  \ supportLocus is vacuous). The certificate difficulty that
makes U2 hard DOES\
  \ NOT EXIST FIBREWISE. Any obligation phrased over a residue field should be
priced\
  \ against DivisorFamilyFieldSurj, not against the relative certificate machinery.
\
  
DJ-0 (compact-image qc) and DJ-2 (packaging) remain landed. JacobianData has seven\
  \ producers
plus the two PicRepDatum entry points; the atlas is NOT finite, so\

    26	  curve point `σ`, a plus class **represented on a module-finite étale cover** is
    27	  in the range of the unit: it comes from an honest relative Picard class.  This
    28	  is the (C2) effectivity theorem repackaged at the plus-class level, with the
    29	  cover kept general (module-finite, not necessarily a field extension).
    30	
    31	## What this does *not* do, and what it isolates
    32	
    33	It does **not** prove ring-level surjectivity of the unit.  Surjectivity over `A`
    34	is equivalent to: *every* plus class of `PicEtAff C A` is represented on **some**
    35	module-finite étale cover.  That equivalence is not a reduction — the reverse
    36	direction is free, because `PicEtAff.unit_eq_mk` represents any in-range class on
    37	the trivial cover `Algebra.EtaleCover.self A`, which is module-finite.  So a
    38	"surjectivity from module-finite-cover representatives" wrapper would merely
    39	re-spell surjectivity, not weaken it, and is deliberately **not** stated here.
    40	
    41	The genuine open obligation the field proof discharges by cofinality, and which
    42	this file does not, is therefore: *refine an arbitrary étale cover of `Spec A`
    43	representing a given plus class to a module-finite one* — false for a general
    44	étale cover of a general ring (see the moving lemma's counterexample,
    45	`EffectivityMoving.lean`), so it must be supplied by the specific curve/base at
    46	hand (e.g. the explicit finite cover of a concrete `Pic` computation).
    47	`mk_mem_range_unit_of_moduleFinite` is the interface such a producer plugs into.
    48	-/

    14	
    15	* (C1) `PicEtAff.unit_injective` (`Picard/CechKernelLemma.lean:361`, Kleiman 2.5(1)) —
    16	  étale separatedness, unconditional on every affine test algebra;

    22	`picEt` / `relPicFunctor`, not through `PicEtAff`: the degree-zero functor `pic0Functor`

    32

    34	comparison isomorphism `picEtAffineEquiv`, so it introduces **no new mathematical
    35	content** and **no new hypothesis** — the field-point equivalence carries exactly the

   130	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   131	
   132	/-- **Surjectivity of the unit of the étale plus construction over a section-admitting
   133	field test** (Kleiman 2.5(2), axiom (C2) — the campaign headline): if the curve admits
   134	a `K`-point `σ`, every class of `PicEtAff C K` comes from a relative Picard class.
   135	
   136	A representative on an étale cover of `Spec K` is refined to a finite separable field
   137	extension (field cofinality); the rigidification layer produces a rigidified Čech
   138	representative whose descent equation holds on the nose; the (C2) effectivity theorem
   139	descends it along the cover inclusion; and the `relPicMk`/`mk`-calculus identifies the
   140	descended class's unit with the original plus class. -/
   141	theorem PicEtAff.unit_surjective_of_section (σ : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
   142	    Function.Surjective (PicEtAff.unit C K) := by
   143	  intro q
   144	  induction q using PicEtAff.ind with | _ E x
   145	  classical
   146	  -- ### refine the representing cover to a finite separable field extension
   147	  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hLalg, hLfin, hLsep, ⟨f⟩⟩ :=
   148	    E.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom
   149	  set F : Algebra.EtaleCover K := Algebra.EtaleCover.ofField (K := K) L with hF
   150	  set g : E.Carrier →ₐ[K] F.Carrier :=
   151	    ((Algebra.EtaleCover.ofFieldEquiv (K := K) L).symm.toAlgHom).comp f with hg
   152	  set y : descentClasses C F := descentMap C g x with hy
   153	  have hq : PicEtAff.mk C E x = PicEtAff.mk C F y :=
   154	    (PicEtAff.mk_descentMap C g x).symm
   155	  haveI : Module.Finite K F.Carrier :=
   156	    Module.Finite.equiv (R := K) (M := L)
   157	      (Algebra.EtaleCover.ofFieldEquiv (K := K) L).symm.toLinearEquiv
   158	  -- ### a rigidified representative of the descent class (G1)
   159	  obtain ⟨Lc, hrig, hLcrep⟩ := relPic.exists_isRigidified_rep
   160	    (Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId K F.Carrier).restrictScalars k) ≫ σ)
   161	    (y : relPic C (overSpec k F.Carrier))
   162	  have hmem : relPicMk C (overSpec k F.Carrier) Lc ∈ descentClasses C F := by
   163	    rw [hLcrep]
   164	    exact y.2
   165	  -- ### the on-the-nose descent equation (the rigidified transport keystone)
   166	  have hdesc0 := Over.IsRigidified.cechPicMap_doubleInl_eq_doubleInr σ hmem hrig
   167	  have hinl : doubleInl (k := k) F = tensorInl (k := k) (A := K) (B := F.Carrier) :=
   168	    AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl
   169	  have hinr : doubleInr (k := k) F = tensorInr (k := k) (A := K) (B := F.Carrier) :=
   170	    AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl
   171	  rw [hinl, hinr] at hdesc0
   172	  -- ### the effectivity theorem
   173	  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Over.exists_cechPic_map_whiskerLeft_eq C σ Lc hrig hdesc0
   174	  refine ⟨relPicMk C (overSpec k K) M, ?_⟩
   175	  -- ### the `mk`-calculus close
   176	  rw [PicEtAff.unit_eq_mk C F (relPicMk C (overSpec k K) M)]
   177	  rw [hq]
   178	  refine congrArg (PicEtAff.mk C F) (Subtype.ext ?_)
   179	  change relPicAlgMap C ((Algebra.ofId K F.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   180	      (relPicMk C (overSpec k K) M) = (y : relPic C (overSpec k F.Carrier))
   181	  rw [relPicAlgMap, relPicMap_mk, hM, hLcrep]
   182	
   183	/-- **The unit of the étale plus construction is an isomorphism over a
   184	section-admitting field test** — étale separatedness (C1) plus effectivity (C2):
   185	`relPic C (Spec K) ≃* PicEtAff C K`. -/
   186	noncomputable def PicEtAff.unitEquiv_of_section (σ : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
   187	    relPic C (overSpec k K) ≃* PicEtAff C K :=
   188	  MulEquiv.ofBijective (PicEtAff.unit C K)
   189	    ⟨PicEtAff.unit_injective C K, PicEtAff.unit_surjective_of_section C K σ⟩
   190	
   191	end close
   192	
   193	end AlgebraicGeometry
